hollow_hart.name: The Hollow Hart

phases.hazard: Root snares mark two lanes before striking
phases.objective: Destroy the two living root anchors

phases.hazard: Thorn growth blocks the central approach
The clearing pulses with draining sap
phases.objective: Expose and defeat the heartwood core

hollow_hart.counterplay: Root anchors suppress the guardian's regeneration; fire and severing attacks are effective.

drowned_crown.name: Admiral Veyr, the Drowned Crown

phases.hazard: Telegraphed cannon lanes cross the deck
A moving gangplank opens a flanking lane
phases.objective: Defeat the tide-callers maintaining the storm

phases.hazard: Flooded deck tiles slow movement

drowned_crown.counterplay: Signal drums coordinate enemy volleys; disabling them reduces incoming ranged pressure.

ash_regent.name: Kharzug the Ash Regent

phases.hazard: Ash shamans shield the throne
Marked cover collapses at round end
Ash vents erupt in announced patterns
phases.objective: Defeat Kharzug before the final eruption

ash_regent.counterplay: Ward pylons protect the boss; ranged attacks can reach them before the ogre advances.

pale_matriarch.name: The Pale Matriarch

phases.hazard: Grave mist obscures distant tiles
Soul threads bind adjacent units
The Matriarch raises one fallen guard
phases.objective: Break her bone spindle and finish the duel

pale_matriarch.counterplay: Banners enable resurrection pulses; destroying them prevents the enemy from recovering fallen units.

briar_sovereign.name: The Briar Sovereign

phases.hazard: Vines reshape two corridors each round
phases.objective: Lure the Sovereign across the prepared ironwood traps

phases.hazard: Pollen clouds weaken clustered units
The colossus charges along a marked line

briar_sovereign.counterplay: Trap tiles interrupt charges and expose the Sovereign; spreading out limits pollen effects.

star_eater.name: The Star-Eater

phases.hazard: Constellation lines mark tiles before impact
Safe tiles rotate after each enemy phase
A central pull draws units toward the core

star_eater.counterplay: Lens activation reveals safe lanes; star nodes delay the arena's tile rotation.

last_cantor.name: The Last Cantor

phases.hazard: The Cantor echoes the party's most-used skill
phases.objective: Vary attacks and break the echoing reliquaries

phases.hazard: Repeated skill families are countered
phases.objective: Rotate physical, magical and support actions

phases.hazard: A marked silence field suppresses one skill category
phases.objective: Defeat the Cantor during the exposed final refrain

last_cantor.counterplay: Avoid repeating the same skill family; reliquaries reveal which actions the Cantor can echo.
